title: Bisikan lam Angen
intro: Bayangkan saboh alam dipat nyang hana deuh ngon nyang deuh meuikat, dan gata teudong dikeue sidroe tokoh di ateuh saboh keurajeuen nyang hana saban ngon nyang laen. Jiwa nyoe na ilme nyang dilua jangkauan biasa, pasukan peurintah nyang mantong jeuet jibayangkan le gob. Bah kheueh meunan, bah kheueh nyang paleng meukuasa jeuet jipeumiyueb lé makhlok nyang ubit, dan keubeunaran mungken teutap teusöm sampoe watée nyang ka teupeuteuntée. Soë tokoh njoë njang pusaka djih meu-gema bak masa-masa?
clues: Ulôn teubri keurajeuen nyang hana teuma jiteurimong lé ureuëng laén óh ka lheueh ulôn.
Lon mewarisi ilme dan hikmah dari ureung chik yang lon sayang.
Angen nyan na dimiyueb peurintah ulôn, jijak meunurot peurintah ulôn ho mantong nyang ulôn keuneuk.
Lon jeuet lon muphom tutoe haba cicem-cicem nyan, dan awaknyan jimeutugaih lam tantra lon.
Lon teurimong haba nibak cicem ubeut teuntang sidroe ratu nyang jiseumah mata uroe.
Keumatian ulôn teutap teusöm sampoë saboh makhluk bumoë djipeu-ék tungkat ulôn, dan barô lheuëh njan djisadar jin-jin njan bahwa awaknjan hana djiteupeuë hai-hai njang ghaib.

location.label: Unsur Kunci
options: Tungkat nyan jikonsumsi le makhluk bumoe .
Tungkat nyang meuubah jeuet keu uleue .
location.answer: Tungkat nyan jikonsumsi le makhluk bumoe .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Mate gobnyan geusom nibak jin sampoe tungkat gobnyan jipajoh .
Gobnyan ka geupeuseulamat nibak apui ngon peurintah Allah .
outcome.answer: Mate gobnyan geusom nibak jin sampoe tungkat gobnyan jipajoh .

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
